async def act(page):
    # Hover over the 'Sales' link to expand the dropdown menu
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sales").first.hover()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for menu to appear
    # Click on the 'Orders' link in the expanded menu
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the Orders page, filter for pending orders
    # Look for a status filter combobox or filters button
    status_filter = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has_text="Status")
    if await status_filter.count() > 0:
        await status_filter.select_option("Pending")
    else:
        # Alternative: open filters and select status
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Filters").click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status").select_option("Pending")
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply Filters").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Get the first row in the orders table (most recent pending order)
    first_order_row = page.get_by_role("row").nth(1)  # Skip header row
    # Click on the order to view details
    await first_order_row.get_by_role("link").first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Extract order ID and purchase date from the order details page
    order_id_element = page.get_by_role("heading").filter(has_text="Order #")
    purchase_date_element = page.get_by_text("Purchase Date")
    order_id = await order_id_element.text_content()
    purchase_date = await purchase_date_element.text_content()
    # Return the result as a string
    return f"Order ID: {order_id}, Purchase Date: {purchase_date}"
